context.summary: Ethan began the year in Los Angeles, producing tracks for an emerging R&B artist in his home studio. He experimented with analog synth layers and ambient reverb to craft a nostalgic yet modern sound for their debut EP.
what: Producing a debut R&B EP using analog synths and ambient effects.

context.summary: In Nashville, Ethan joined a songwriting retreat with country and folk musicians. Over a week, they co-wrote several tracks blending acoustic storytelling with electronic textures — one of which later charted regionally.
what: Collaborating at a cross-genre songwriting retreat.

context.summary: Ethan traveled to Seoul to collaborate with a K-pop producer on an upbeat fusion single. The session combined Western bass grooves with traditional Korean percussion instruments, creating a unique global rhythm.
what: Producing a global fusion track with a K-pop producer.

context.summary: In Berlin, Ethan attended an electronic music expo to present his modular sound design software. He hosted a demo booth and conducted workshops on blending AI-driven sound synthesis with human creativity.
what: Presenting music software and hosting workshops at an expo.

context.summary: Ethan returned to New York to mentor aspiring producers at a youth music program. He discussed creative workflows, mixing fundamentals, and encouraged participants to develop authentic personal sounds.
what: Mentoring young producers at a community music workshop.

context.summary: In Barcelona, Ethan performed a live DJ set at a summer festival, combining ambient house with sampled city sounds. The performance attracted a large audience and was later streamed by an independent music platform.
what: Performing a DJ set blending ambient and cityscape audio samples.

context.summary: Ethan spent early autumn in Tokyo, collaborating remotely with artists across three continents. He mixed and mastered multiple singles from his hotel studio, building a reputation for fast, high-quality remote production.
what: Mixing and mastering global projects remotely.

context.summary: In Toronto, Ethan reunited with Amara to record their second collaboration, a stripped-down acoustic version of their earlier single. The intimate sound received positive feedback for its emotional depth.
what: Recording an acoustic duet with a previous collaborator.

context.summary: Ethan ended the year back in Los Angeles, curating a charity concert featuring artists he worked with throughout 2025. The event raised funds for youth music programs and closed with his emotional piano performance.
what: Hosting a charity concert featuring collaborators from his year's projects.
